name: domsep-heat-cannot-connect-to-electrical
source:
ThermalSource TS(T=300)
Resistor      R(R=10)
connect(TS.port, R.a)

error.message: connect(ts.port, r.a): cannot connect a heat port (ts.port) to a electrical port (r.a) — different physical domains. Couple domains through a transducer component (a motor, pump, heating resistor, …), not a direct connect.
